articles.title: Metaplanet CEO breaks silence but shareholders say the hard questions remain unanswered
articles.snippet: Simon Gerovich said Metaplanet had not adequately explained the structure, and denied involvement in MMXX Ventures’ trading decisions.

articles.title: Cronos confirms $9.2M slipped away before Tectonic exploit rollback
articles.snippet: Cronos’s post-mortem put the Tectonic exploit’s affected borrowing at $120.4 million, with 7.6% transferred off-network before validators intervened.

articles.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
articles.snippet: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.

articles.title: Stablecoins Won't Scale Without Banks
articles.snippet: With a growing number of institutions exploring stablecoins, the bottleneck is regulated infrastructure they can trust.
